Messages.Author: Cecil
Messages.Body:
So it is my turn, and my prey has Shalmath, and I have an untapped
Salubri with advanced Obeah.

If my prey untaps Shalmath during my turn after I have declared I am
done, can I immediately play spirit marionette or do I have to wait to
see if they will use Shalmath first?

Cecil

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


You mean "during my minion phase, after I have passed (declaring no
further actions at this time)".

Yes, if Shalmath untaps during your minion phase, the impulse returns
to you (the acting Methuselah).

If he untaps during your influence phase, however, the impulse still
returns to you, but your minions would not be able to take an action.

Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:


You can play Spirit Marionnette at OBE. Or at obe. Untapping Shalmath
is using the between-action impulse.
The next impulse to declare actions is yours, since it is your turn.
